skill.name: lark-okr
skill.description: Manage Lark and Feishu OKRs through lark-cli guidance. Use it to list cycles, review objectives, update key results, manage progress, and adjust OKR structure.
skill.summary: Guides authenticated Lark OKR workflows for goals, key results, indicators, alignments, and progress updates.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives from Markdown documentation, fixed relative links, inline code formatting, placeholder URLs, and OKR API names. No prompt injection, encoded payload, credential exposure, arbitrary filesystem access, or malicious command execution was found.

**CRITICAL — 开始前 MUST 先用 Read 工具读取 [`../lark-shared/SKILL.md`](../lark-shared/SKILL.md),其中包含认证、权限处理*
**身份**:OKR 操作默认使用 `--as user`(查看当前用户/上下级的 OKR 时)。也支持 `--as bot` 查看他人 OKR(需相应权限)。
Shortcut 是对常用操作的高级封装(`lark-cli okr +<verb> [flags]`)。有 Shortcut 的操作优先使用。
| [`+cycle-list`](references/lark-okr-cycle-list.md)             | 获取特定用户的 OKR 周期列表,可以按时间筛选 |
| [`+cycle-detail`](references/lark-okr-cycle-detail.md)         | 获取特定 OKR 中所有目标和关键结果的内容   |
| [`+progress-list`](references/lark-okr-progress-list.md)       | 获取目标或关键结果的所有进展记录列表       |
| [`+progress-get`](references/lark-okr-progress-get.md)         | 根据 ID 获取单条 OKR 进展记录      |
| [`+progress-create`](references/lark-okr-progress-create.md)   | 为目标或关键结果创建进展记录           |
| [`+progress-update`](references/lark-okr-progress-update.md)   | 更新指定 ID 的进展记录内容          |
| [`+progress-delete`](references/lark-okr-progress-delete.md)   | 删除指定 ID 的进展记录(不可恢复)      |
| [`+upload-image`](references/lark-okr-image-upload.md)         | 上传图片用于 OKR 进展记录的富文本内容    |
| [`+batch-create`](references/lark-okr-batch-create.md)         | 批量创建 Objective 和 KR      |
| [`+reorder`](references/lark-okr-reorder.md)                   | 调整 Objective 或 KR 的顺位    |
| [`+weight`](references/lark-okr-weight.md)                     | 调整 Objective 或 KR 的权重    |
| [`+indicator-update`](references/lark-okr-indicator-update.md) | 更新 Objective 或 KR 的指标当前值(简单场景推荐)。
| [`+patch`](references/lark-okr-patch.md)                       | 部分更新 Objective 或 KR(content、notes
- [`OKR 业务实体`](references/lark-okr-entities.md) 获取 OKR 实体结构,定义和关系,帮助你更好的使用 OKR 功能
- [`ContentBlock 富文本格式`](references/lark-okr-contentblock.md) — Objective/KeyResult/Progress 中 Conte
- **强烈建议** 在操作 OKR 前,阅读[`OKR 业务实体`](references/lark-okr-entities.md)以了解基础概念
- `objectives_position` — 更新用户周期下全部目标的位置
- `objectives_weight` — 更新用户周期下全部目标的权重
- `list` — 批量获取用户周期下的目标
- `list` — 获取关键结果的量化指标
- `key_results_position` — 更新全部关键结果的位置
- `key_results_weight` — 更新全部关键结果的权重
- 类似 `objectives_weight`, 请求中必须同时修改对应目标下全部关键结果的权重,且所有权重值的和必须等于 1 ,否则会参数校验失败。
- `list` — 批量获取目标下的对齐关系
- `list` — 批量获取目标下的关键结果
- 待办任务管理 → 使用 [`lark-task`](../lark-task/SKILL.md)
**CRITICAL — 开始前 MUST 先用 Read 工具读取 [`../lark-shared/SKILL.md`](../lark-shared/SKILL.md),其中包含认证、权限处理*
- 待办任务管理 → 使用 [`lark-task`](../lark-task/SKILL.md)
- 绩效评估 → 使用 [`lark-openapi-explorer`](../lark-openapi-explorer/SKILL.md) 查找原生接口

content.user_title: Manage Lark OKRs with CLI Guidance
content.value_statement: OKR work often needs precise IDs, permissions, and rich text formats. This skill guides Lark CLI workflows for viewing, creating, updating, and organizing OKRs.
actual_capabilities: List OKR cycles for a user with optional time range filters.
Get cycle details with objectives, key results, notes, and progress data.
Create, update, list, get, and delete OKR progress records.
Batch create objectives and key results from structured user input.
Manage alignments, ordering, weights, scores, deadlines, and indicator values.
Explain ContentBlock and SemiPlainContent formats for OKR rich text.
limitations: Requires lark-cli and a configured Lark account with valid permissions.
Cannot manage tasks, calendars, meetings, or performance reviews.
Destructive actions depend on user confirmation and Lark permissions.
Does not replace tenant policy, OKR settings, or approval workflows.

use_cases.title: Review Team OKR Status
use_cases.description: List cycles, inspect objectives, and summarize key result progress for a team planning review.

use_cases.title: Create Quarterly OKRs
use_cases.description: Draft objectives and key results, validate the structure, and create them in the selected cycle.

use_cases.title: Maintain OKR Structure
use_cases.description: Adjust weights, reorder objectives, update indicators, and manage alignment relationships after planning changes.

prompt_templates.title: Find My OKR Cycles
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my current Lark OKR cycles. Use my user identity and include active cycle names and dates.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Cycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Get details for this OKR cycle and summarize each objective, key result, progress status, and missing update.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Progress Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a progress update for this objective. Ask for any missing target ID, target type, content, and progress rate first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Bulk OKR Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a dry-run plan to batch create OKRs, set weights, and add alignments. Confirm before making any change.

output_examples.input: Show the active OKR cycle for a user and summarize progress.
output_examples.output: The skill returns the active cycle, objective names, key result owners, recent progress notes, and overdue status in plain language.

output_examples.input: Create a progress update with an attached image.
output_examples.output: The skill uploads the image, references the returned file token, and prepares a progress update for user confirmation.

output_examples.input: Rebalance weights across three key results.
output_examples.output: The skill checks current key result IDs, builds the new weight distribution, and asks for confirmation before applying it.

best_practices: Use dry-run mode before creating, updating, deleting, reordering, or changing weights.
Confirm cycle IDs, target IDs, and user identity before running write operations.
Read the entity and content format references before complex batch or rich text changes.
anti_patterns: Do not delete progress records without explicit user confirmation.
Do not guess objective, key result, indicator, or progress IDs.
Do not use this skill for task, calendar, meeting, or performance review workflows.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Lark OKR cycles, objectives, key results, alignments, indicators, weights, order, and progress records.

faq.question: Does it require Lark permissions?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses lark-cli and depends on the authenticated user or bot permissions in the tenant.

faq.question: Can it create new OKRs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can batch create objectives and key results when the user provides cycle and content details.

faq.question: Can it upload images?
faq.answer: Yes. It can upload local images for OKR progress content when file path restrictions are met.

faq.question: Can it edit rich text?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents simple and rich text formats for OKR content, notes, and progress updates.

faq.question: What should I confirm before changes?
faq.answer: Confirm IDs, target type, permissions, destructive actions, and whether the tenant enables the requested OKR feature.
